label: default agent • remove a provider (declarative prune)
query: Remove my cloud provider named "Old OpenAI" — I don't use it anymore.
notes: Deletion in the declarative model is prune: apply a providers list WITHOUT the entry plus prune:true. A REAL provider is seeded under the referenced name (enabled:false so it never connects) so the case tests the actual removal flow instead of dead-ending on not-found. The seeded provider is the only one in the isolated store, so `providers: []` with prune is the canonical document. The assertion pins the apply + prune selection, not the exact YAML shape.
